Authentic Browser Rendering / Engineering Fixture

One page. Every section. No invented interactions.

This local site is an isolated test fixture designed to validate a real-wheel browsing sequence and deterministic duration estimate, not a customer product.

View the workflow
01 — Overview

Show each section without skipping the details.

The scroll controller should not assume every heading is a reason for a second pause. A viewer needs enough time to absorb the content at each screenful, not a mechanical pause on every nested card.

Natural browser geometry and its sticky header must remain intact. The cursor should settle away from important labels while the camera stays flat and source-accurate.

02 — Recording

Real wheels. Captured pixels. Verified frames.

Every planned wheel event is issued to Chromium. Frames are captured after those events and encoded into a 60 frame-per-second H.264 film with no artificial interface or fabricated click.

03 — Complete

Nothing to invent.

This is a controlled offline fixture. A real production site still requires a hardened sandbox and representative end-to-end tests.
